from.place: Affine global Hom comparison: normalize pullback adjunctions using the original derived counit

title: Original-counit transport of the normalized scheme pullback adjunction
statement: For schemes T,S with fixed derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and g:T→S, use the fixed derived pullback Lg and derived direct image Rg [def-pc-derived-pullback] [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let a be the legacy normalized adjunction [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction]. Let a₀ and δ:Lg≅Lg be the original-counit adjunction and universal change of counit [lem-pc-global-hom-original-counit-normalization]. Then a equals a₀ transported on its left functor along δ⁻¹. In particular this theorem makes no assertion that δ is identity.

source.place: Tag 09T5 (derived adjunctions and universal properties); cohomology.tex Tag 06YJ (derived pullback). The normalization-uniqueness calculation is supplied explicitly by F2.

proof.text: The existing derived-adjunction theorem supplies the representative Hom normalization for a using the composition-family counit. For a₀ transported along δ⁻¹, Mathlib homEquiv_ofNatIsoLeft_apply inserts δ⁻¹ on the input. The inverse counit factorization δ⁻¹;ε=ε₀ reduces its Hom equation to the original derived-adjunction normalization.

The K-injective right-derivability structure makes Rg⋙Lg an absolute right-derived functor with the direct-image unit whiskered by Lg. Apply uniqueness of normalized derived adjunctions to the two equations of the preceding step.

proof_origin.note: Explicit triangle-identity and right-derived-extensionality proof; no unproved auxiliary result added.
